name: The Burned Kingdom
source:
Follow Eira (name changeable) as she becomes a lady in waiting to the princess in a fantasy world of magic where everything isn't as it seems and a dark threat looms over the entire kingdom, threatening its destruction. 

[From [url=https://bumblebee-storytelling.itch.io/the-burned-kingdom]Itch.io[/url]]
